states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter state codes to import. Leave empty for all 50 states.

targetWithPhones.title: Target rows with phones
targetWithPhones.description: Stop once this many breeders with at least one phone number are saved (0 = no limit).

onlyWithPhones.title: Only save rows with phones
onlyWithPhones.description: Skip breeders whose contact details have no phone number.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between contact lookups (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Pause before each breeder contact lookup. Slower pacing hits angus.org's rate limit less often.

blockPauseMinutes.title: Pause when throttled (minutes)
blockPauseMinutes.description: How long to wait after angus.org starts returning empty lookups. Doubles on each consecutive block, up to 120 minutes.

maxBreeders.title: Max breeders
maxBreeders.description: Stop after this many breeders are saved (0 = no limit). Useful for test runs.
